title: GPU memory accounting
objective: Measure and bound GPU resources outside the enforced photo-slot and rendering budgets before any total-memory guarantee.
context_summary: The GPU is the renderer of record for display, counts, samples, export and developed catalog tiers. Full-photo slots share one 1 GiB aggregate (FULL_CEILING), with at most 512 MiB per allocation; the former region sets no longer exist. The surface's GPU-preview allocations share a separate 2 GiB budget; the desktop's tile worker uses its own device and a separate 2 GiB GPU_TILE_BUDGET. These are application charges, not a total GPU or process bound. Crop-stage raster textures, clipping and coverage overlays, backend staging and device/pipeline overhead need accounting and native measurement. The owner's provisional 1088 MiB ceiling described the former full-photo and region slots; it is not the current allocation shape. Decisions: docs/decisions.md.

tasks.description: Measure and bound GPU resources outside the current photo-slot, GPU-preview and tile-worker budgets before making a total-memory guarantee.
extra_context: A standalone follow-up under the owner's provisional residency acceptance, required before any total-memory claim. No other rendering task is a prerequisite.

Photo slots (photo_surface.rs): FULL_BUDGET is 512 MiB per allocation and FULL_CEILING is 1 GiB shared by all surfaces' resident and retiring full allocations. Mips count in that allocation. No separate region sets remain; REGION_BUCKET_BUDGET is a 32 MiB output-reservation bucket limit, not an additional residency allowance. The historical provisional 1088 MiB acceptance is not an enforced total GPU ceiling.

GPU-preview budget (gpu_preview.rs), 2 GiB shared by surfaces: held source pixels; derived boundaries; view and rest-tile slots, output, link intermediates, kept planes, program buffers and the shared scratch pool; the rest's accumulator and stage textures; histogram buffers and readbacks; light reducers and the bounded cache of eight one-texel lights. Retirement keeps the relevant charges until GPU completion. A boundary is separately limited to 256 MiB. A rest tile's share is derived from what the source, view plan, accumulator and stages leave, capped at 1.25 GiB (REST_SHARE_MAX).

Tile worker (gpu_preview/tiles.rs and app/gpu_tiles.rs), GPU_TILE_BUDGET 2 GiB apart from the preview budget: source window, slot, chain and scratch, light-sweep reducer, staged-stream textures, output/readback copies, in-flight and spare copies, and still-pinned resources. At most two tiles are in flight; streams reserve 256 MiB for reads and hold at most two output bands for the encoder. The worker keeps at most 64 compiled sequences and eight lights; audit their retained allocations and its separate device's overhead rather than treating the runner's charge as native GPU residency.

Outside those byte charges: crop-stage raster textures and their aprons, clipping and mask-coverage raster overlays, small drawing uniforms, backend upload/readback staging, compiled pipelines and device/driver allocations. Compare's retained CPU frames and full-photo textures, including mips, must be distinguished from genuinely excluded allocations. Crop input stages are now rendered on the GPU where supported, with reference raster textures only where required; the old CPU proxy/exact crop figures are evidence for the previous path, not the current peak.

Inventory every allocation and retirement path before proposing caps or a total bound. Measure representative 24 MP and 60 MP JPEG/RAW workflows on the native M4, including Fit and percentage views, crop, clipping, masks, Compare, commits, export and catalog tiers alongside reads. Correlate application charges, process counters and native GPU allocations; account for overlap across the window device and the tile worker's device. Windows/Linux remain separately qualified.

Owner, 2026-10-07: GPU attribution must be available through resources.read and the Performance panel. The desktop supplies its surface and tile-device charges to the core through a bounded host reporting seam; this is an API extension to build, not existing resources.read output. Distinguish application charges, native counters, retirement and unmeasured overhead, and avoid double-counting shared unified-memory residency.

acceptance_criteria: Native M4 evidence accounts separately for full-photo slots, GPU-preview resources, tile-worker resources, crop and overlay textures, compiled/device overhead and backend staging on representative 24 MP and 60 MP workloads, including temporary overlap and retirement.

Each excluded allocation path has an enforced byte cap or a derived peak-byte bound from bounded allocation sizes and maximum simultaneous overlap, including retirement; resource-limit behaviour is explicit where a cap refuses work.

The measured scope and any resulting total editor/GPU bound are documented without treating either 2 GiB rendering budget or the 1 GiB full-photo ceiling as a process-wide guarantee; Windows/Linux remain separately qualified.

resources.read and the Performance panel expose the same host-supplied GPU attribution, with explicit unavailable or unmeasured values where no provider supplies evidence, bounded reporting and tests for retirement and unified-memory double-counting.

steps: Inventory current surface, crop, overlay, light, histogram, Compare, tile-runner and backend allocation and retirement paths. Capture native allocations during representative Fit and 100% crop, edit, pan, export and read transitions at 24 MP and 60 MP. The existing crop-start mode is Fit-only and rejects --zoom; add a measured percentage-crop path if needed, without documenting it as an existing command.
Add the smallest enforceable accounting or limits for omitted resources and verify overlap, retirement and refusal behavior in focused surface tests.
Repeat native measurement on the bounded implementation, correlate GPU and process counters with application slot logs, and update the design, performance evidence and feature status.
commands: cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- editor-latency --source fixtures/generated/60mp.jpg --output NEW_DIR --mode crop-start --presence --samples 5
cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- editor-latency --source fixtures/generated/60mp.jpg --output NEW_DIR --mode drag --zoom 100
cargo run --release --locked --package xtask -- verify --tier quick --output NEW_DIR
expected_results: Excluded GPU resources have evidence-backed bounds or explicitly remain unqualified; no total-memory guarantee is asserted without complete accounting.
